name: Mentor Life
source:
The state faction is opening a new college where you will take on the role as a mentor for a special mission. You will patrol the campus, visit clubs, dorm rooms, and keep an eye out for students who break college rules. What you will do every day at the college will be followed by a much more complex and special mission. A mission that has haunted you since you were a student at a similar college.

[From [url=https://brdsky.itch.io/mentor-life]itch.io[/url]]
